title: PersonalClaw marketing screenshot, video and content manifest
description: The single source of truth binding each marketing screenshot to the real-world scenario it must depict, the app view it is captured from, the exact image spec, and the site placements + copy it drives. Update this FIRST for a release, then let it drive the re-capture + content refresh (see marketing/README.md).

targetRelease.description: The core version these shots depict, e.g. '0.1.2'. Screenshots must be captured against this RELEASED build (a tag), never an unmerged branch.

capture.description: How the seeded screenshot instance is stood up (see the runbook). Documented here so a fresh operator/subagent reproduces the same environment.

instance.description: How to obtain the seeded gateway (e.g. 'clone .dev-home -> .screenshot-home, run a second gateway on port 10001'). Inherits the existing provider config rather than re-wiring.

theme.description: Must match the site's rendering context (the site renders app imagery on a dark surface; playwright.config colorScheme is 'dark').

aspectRatio.description: Every app screenshot is a strict 8:5 crop (DESIGN.md). A replacement that breaks this forces layout/CSS changes.

clips.description: Recorded clips of the released app, captured with the shots at each release and kept under marketing/.captures/clips/ (not committed): what a video shows in motion, such as the agent orb's states. scripts/render-videos.mjs stages each source a video names into its composition.

videos.description: Every video the site plays (#94): what it is made from, the release it shows, where it plays and the rules it plays by. scripts/validate-marketing-manifest.mjs holds each shipping entry's files and budget, and src/components/loop-video.mjs plays a loop by its autoplay policy.

id.description: Stable slug (matches the asset basename without extension).

asset.description: Repo-relative path to the committed PNG source. Astro derives all responsive WebP variants from it at build.

appView.description: Which PersonalClaw UI surface/route to capture (e.g. 'Dashboard home', 'Settings -> Doctor'). Human instruction for the capture operator.

minWidth.description: The capture must be AT LEAST this wide so no responsive variant upscales (>= the largest width requested by the placement's <Image>/getImage call). At 8:5, height follows.

scenario.description: The real-world use-case data that MUST be visibly present in this shot — the narrative to seed before capturing (e.g. 'a goal loop mid-run with 3 completed steps + a live step, findings visible'). This is what makes the shot show PersonalClaw at its best.

value.description: The product value this shot is meant to communicate (the 'why we show this').

captureBlockedBy.description: Optional: a tracking reference (e.g. a GitHub issue URL) for a bug that PREVENTS re-capturing this shot for the current targetRelease. The shot still ships with its existing (prior-release) asset; it is re-captured once the blocker clears. Its presence means 'known-stale, deliberately not re-shot this release'.

placements.description: Every site location that renders this asset, with the copy that goes alongside. Editing copy here is a checklist for the actual edit at the cited file. May be empty ONLY for a 'new-needs-placement' shot (the validator enforces that a shipping shot names at least one placement).

status.description: shipping = has a site placement and is RE-CAPTURED EVERY RELEASE (there is no 'still current, skip it' — even small UI shifts change a shot, so all shipping shots are re-shot against each targetRelease); new-needs-placement = a candidate shot with no site home yet (owner decides placement before it ships); retired = to be removed from the site + this manifest.

file.description: Repo-relative site file that renders the asset (e.g. 'src/pages/product.astro').

kind.description: Rendering mechanism: for a shot, the tabbed hero (getImage) or an Astro <Image> on a page; for a video, the hero loop in the System Window, a feature loop beside its section, the product tour, the release page or a social frame.

caption.description: The visible caption/title copy (hero tabs source this from src/data/site.ts productViews).

alt.description: The alt text at the call site.

scenario.description: What the clip must show, beat by beat: the real work to seed before recording it.

kind.description: A loop is short, silent and muted, and repeats. A narrative video plays once and carries captions.

composition.description: The Hyperframes composition it is rendered from, or null for a raw recording made before the pipeline existed.

sources.description: The ids of the shots or recorded clips it is made from. Empty only for a raw recording.

capturedAt.description: The core release its captures show.

posterAtSeconds.description: Where render:videos takes the poster from the render, in seconds; 0 when absent.

crf.description: The encoder's constant rate factor for render:videos (lower is higher quality), so a loop fits its budget; the CLI's delivery quality when absent.

width.description: The video's box, so the poster, the first frame and a failed load take the same space.

poster.description: A real, release-pinned frame: shown first, and alone under reduced motion or data saver.

captions.description: Required for a narrative video; null for a silent loop.

chapters.description: 'captions' when its chapters are read from the captions track (src/data/tour.mjs); null for none.

budgetBytes.description: The most the output may weigh, in bytes.

autoplay.description: none: no byte loads before an explicit play. idle-hint: once the page is idle it may start, muted, and only while reduced motion and data saver are both off.

fallback.description: What a reader keeps when the video fails or is off: the poster, and the text beside it.

audio.description: Every audio asset it uses, with its source and licence.
